observations: I opened assets/panels/05-3.png, main-cast.png and page-05.png with Read.
Meera faces screen-right with a warm open-mouth smile. Her round eyes, high brows, braid over her left shoulder, blue kurta and silver bangle match the sheet.
Her open hand gesturing toward Ravi's phone wears the bangle, so it is her right. Her left hand rests on the desk. This matches production.hands.meera.

Ravi is seen from behind in the right foreground: the back of his head, his beard edge and his green shoulder. He holds the phone in the hand with the wristwatch, which is his left, with the screen toward Meera. This matches production.hands.ravi and the ravi-phone record, and keeps Meera-left / Ravi-right from 05-1.

The phone screen shows a calendar card and a person-icon card, with grey placeholder bars. There are no letters or readable data. Non-blocking: the cards differ from the calendar and heart shown in 05-2, which can read as a different app view during the walkthrough.
The reception background is tidy, with the monitor and keyboard (backs and keys only) and waiting patients from behind. The top of the art is blank white space reserved for lettering.
Lettering on page-05.png: the bubble fills the top white area, with its tail down to Meera's mouth. It clears her face and does not cover Ravi's head.
